compose_action_brief.brief:
## Findings
Kenya poverty headcount at 36.1%. M-Pesa covers 67% of adults.
## Citations
- https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SI.POV.DDAY?locations=KE
- https://www.gsma.com/mobilefordevelopment/mobile-money-in-kenya
## Limits
Data from 2016-2022; no household panel survey.
## Actors
Central banks, Mobile money operators, MFI networks
## Verify
- Confirm latest WB poverty estimate
- Cross-check FINDEX mobile account penetration
